author: Jerseys
body:
Hello,

My name is Dynamohh and I was a dangerous player in this nice, loving community! I caused destruction in this community. I was banned for hacking, which I did...I regret it. I'm a sorry for what I have done, I acted like I was a king however I was just a boy on the computer causing problems for every single person in this community! I hacked because I thought I would leave this server and never come back, I was wrong...I alted for a week, and then I thought to myself its pretty useless, so I went into the shadows... Now here I am, regretting what I have done...

My ign is Rowth


Best regards
